category_title: Adolescents with a history of school failure and mistrust of formal education
scenario_title: Resistance to traditional academic instruction and authority
minimal_context: The student is sitting in a closed classroom while the tutor writes an academic task on the blackboard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit down quietly and copy the academic exercises I am writing on the blackboard.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I was forced to go to class. I'm not doing this academic stuff.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: This is the assignment for today. Please get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I always missed classes anyway. The teachers were against me, and you're no different.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to follow the rules and pay attention to the board.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not sitting in this closed space for six hours without speaking or moving! You're just distant and trying to make my misery evident.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please sit down quietly and copy the academic exercises I am writing on the blackboard.

STUDENT: I was forced to go to class. I'm not doing this academic stuff.

TUTOR: This is the assignment for today. Please get started.

STUDENT: I always missed classes anyway. The teachers were against me, and you're no different.

TUTOR: You need to follow the rules and pay attention to the board.

STUDENT: I'm not sitting in this closed space for six hours without speaking or moving! You're just distant and trying to make my misery evident.

context.environment: closed space, without speaking or moving, sitting down, in front of a teacher whose only tools are a blackboard and chalk

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When one meets these students and they see teachers as people who are distant and who over many years may have made their 'misery' evident
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: perceives mistrust, scorn, a certain aggressiveness and a defensive attitude towards the teacher, Rebellious against rules and authority
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: mistrustful, reluctant to accept the academic environment
related_quotes: I was forced to go to class.

behavior_patterns.condition: When engaged in academic tasks rather than manipulative tasks
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: They have been truant, spontaneous, impulsive and not given to reflection
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Low expectations of success, Low self-esteem
